A fragment anchor link is extracted into metadata.links when extract_metadata is true

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Jump to <a href="#section">section</a> below.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_metadata: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.metadata.links.inspect
```
